name: Chinese national standards (GB 50009, GB 50011, GB 50010, GB 50017)
description: The Chinese national standards (alpha 9 track C20), a pack that extends BNBC 2020. Loads: GB 55001-2021 (γG 1.3, γQ 1.5, ψc 0.7 live and 0.6 wind) with GB 50009-2012 (floor live loads by use with the 2021 values, the reduction by floors of 5.1.2, wk = βz μs μz w0 with μz of terrain A-D, μs 0.8/-0.5 and βz at least 1.2, the cities' w0 and s0, roof snow μr s0). Earthquake: GB 50011-2010 (2016 edition) and GB 55002-2021: intensities 6-9 with αmax of the frequent and rare earthquakes, design earthquake groups 1-3 and site classes I0-IV giving Tg (the city's group sets it), the seismic influence coefficient spectrum with the damping adjustment η1, η2, γ (generic method influenceCoefficient), the base shear method with Geq = 0.85 GE and Fi ∝ Gi Hi, the modal method, the minimum shear coefficient λ, the seismic combination 1.3(G + 0.5Q) + 1.4E, the elastic drift limits by structure type (1/550 frame, 1/800 frame-wall, 1/1000 wall, 1/250 steel) and the two-level design: the elasto-plastic storey drift under the rare earthquake by the simplified method Δup = ηp Δue (limits 1/50 frame, 1/100 frame-wall, 1/120 wall), and the seismic grades 一-四 by structure type, intensity and height (Table 6.1.2, raised one degree for 乙 buildings) with their factors ηc, ηv, μN and λv reported. Concrete: GB 50010-2010 design strengths (fc = fck/1.4 of C20-C80, fy = fyk/γs), the rectangular block α1 fc over β1 xc with εcu, the axial capacity 0.9 (fc A + fy' As'), beam shear 0.7 ft b h0 + fyv Asv h0/s within 0.25 βc fc b h0, HRB400/HRB500 bars Φ6-Φ40, the column steel limits. Steel: GB 50017-2017 members: f = fy/γR, the width-thickness classes S1-S5, φ of the section classes a-d by the Perry constants of Appendix D, γx 1.05, shear, tension 0.7 fu An. Not covered and taken from BNBC 2020 (named so in the report): concrete torsion, punching, crack width, deflection, cover by environment class, anchorage la/laE, walls, slender columns, the detailing by grade inside the member design (the grade's factors are reported, not applied), the seismic adjustment factor γRE, the steel connections and seismic steel, φb of GB 50017 (the parent method's χLT is used), GB 50007 foundations (fa with ηb/ηd, the settlement ψs) and the other tables not in covers. Every value names its clause; VERIFY.md lists them, with the uncertain ones, for checking against the printed standards.
